text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Definitely, absolutely, without a doubt, 
no matter what—!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving it up!!!!!!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What was... that run just now...? What 
was... that...?

—I saw a star. One that outshone the 
myriad stellar jewels of the Mejiro... A 
once-in-a-lifetime shooting star.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Heh...

A desperate dash that burned through all 
her spirit... leaving her unable to utter 
even a single 'thank you.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So this is... what it means to run away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo 2400m... You can't win unless you 
run away with this kind of spirit. 
Incredible... It's just way too 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: ...I-NES! I-NES!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

"A chant naturally arose, filling the 
entire venue."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. I'm sorry I couldn't win.
choice_data_list: No, you were stronger than all that, Ines.
No, you were stronger than that, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm an Umamusume too. I shouldn't 
go around celebrating someone else's 
victory over my own...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can't stay a "good girl" forever. Even 
so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today! Just for now, after 
seeing a run like that!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Louder! Make some more 
nooooise!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I-NES, WAY!! I-NES, WAY!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Audience
text_block_list.text: I-NES, WAY!! I-NES, WAY!!

Fired up by Mejiro Palmer's hype, the 
party-people chants grew even louder. The 
celebratory cheers echoed endlessly.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see☆ Ines's run today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Assuming I do that, then my bestie will 
run away too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just had a flash of inspiration for 
a totally killer move, ya know?☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It's a God-tier plan, but probs zero 
chance♪ More importantly, come on, let's 
get back to chilling out!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shake up this soda pop☆, pop the cap, and 
inside—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mantis Caller ★★★ Fooooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh, isn't that bad?! Oh no... 
Gyaaaah!!

And so, the foam party celebrating a job 
well done at the Derby went on late into 
the night.
